sources.finding: Pinned native verifier returns bool using its native time window, without replay consumption or a matched-counter result. Reuse verification; do not equate current server step with the matched step.

Existing framework hashing can protect a bounded set of short-lived used-code verifiers. Bind explicit supported work factor and clock/acceptance horizon; compare every live verifier under existing Account lock.
Native key generation is available. ResetAuthenticatorKeyAsync and SetTwoFactorEnabledAsync change the security stamp; they must not silently select Tunner session effects.
Default authenticator/recovery token storage retains raw values; adapt the approved store boundary to immutable secret-store references, not raw Identity token values.
Standards-based TOTP uses a shared secret and time moving factor; verification and replay limits must be supported explicitly rather than invented as production defaults.
Prevent reuse while an OTP remains valid. Factor/context evidence governs assurance; no phishing-resistant or hardware/AAL3 property is inferred from a TOTP name.
Existing approved provider supports versioned values and create-only CAS. Versioned read, retirement and destruction are distinct capabilities; keep provider and lifecycle choices explicit.

Considered remote verifier; its documented valid response does not supply a SQL-joined idempotent attempt receipt. Inference: timeout/owner rollback would need additional finality handling, so it is not the minimal native-verifier replacement.
Identity templates do not themselves generate QR; current approved application dependencies have no renderer.

decision: Reuse approved native Identity verification, existing framework PasswordHasher and current OpenBao transport behind a narrow per-credential versioned-reference adapter. Use transactional replay state across activation/MFA/operation proof; no new OTP math, hashing key or package is selected.
transaction_boundary: External seed preparation/reconciliation occurs outside the shared Identity owner callback.
Code acceptance plus replay claim and operation-proof issuance commit atomically; existing proof consumption/owner/outbox remains a separate exact continuation transaction.
Primary MFA acceptance plus final session/result/outbox commit atomically; no StepUpProofRow requiring a session is used as a provisional live login session.
limits: A bounded set prevents A→B→A replay; last code/time alone is insufficient.
Native bool result requires conservative full acceptance-horizon retention and supported clock bounds; repeated numeric values may be conservatively rejected within that bound.
QR rendering package/capability must follow package governance if an existing approved compatible implementation is unavailable. No renderer dependency is selected by this preparation.
boundary: Primary-source R&D and test fixtures do not approve production values/provider bindings/retention/assurance/session effects or UX deviations.
